decision.title: Authentication for internal admin panel
decision.context: This decision defines how authentication is handled for an internal admin panel used by operations and engineering teams.

statement.technical_goal: Restrict access to internal admin panel to authorized internal users while keeping operational overhead low.
statement.assumptions: The admin panel is only accessible from internal network or VPN. Admin users have separate corporate accounts.
statement.conscious_simplifications: We do not implement MFA in the first iteration to reduce friction for internal teams.
statement.non_negotiables: Credentials must not be hardcoded. Authentication logic must be centralized.
statement.accepted_worst_case: If internal network trust is broken, attacker may gain admin access until credentials are rotated.
